title: Hold a firearms dealer licence
what: Carry on activities as a firearms dealer, or possess firearms as a dealer, only under a firearms dealer licence.

sources.title: Firearms Act 1996 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on activities as a firearms dealer, or (b) possess a firearm in the person's capacity as a firearms dealer, unless authorised to do so by a firearms dealer licence.
